I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this small sorghum plot because my FISP coupons must go to the maize, but I will put manure here since the plot is close to home and owned by us. I will plant local seed I saved from last season, and I will not spray any chemicals or irrigate because the rains in Mulanje are enough and those things cost too much money that I do not have. My family will do all the work—planting, weeding, and harvesting—because the plot is small and we cannot afford to hire anyone.
